text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Nishino 
Flower...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Nishino Flower 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list:
Do you want to try taking on the 
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-Alright... which one should I aim for...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I couldn't get a single one...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there's a trick to it after all. 
It certainly doesn't come easily...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you sure... Is that really 
okay!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll cheer you on with all 
my might! Trainer, do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
